## How the work is structured

Each capability below is **fixed-scope and time-boxed**: a defined
deliverable, a defined turnaround, no open-ended drift. The starting
move is a short conversation about the problem — what the well or the
programme actually is, what decision the work has to support, and what
data exists. If there is a fit, I set out the scope, the deliverable and
the timeline in writing before anything begins.

::: {.callout-tip appearance="simple"}
**Not sure which area fits?**
[Get in touch](#contact) and describe the problem. I will tell you which
capability is right — or that none of them is and you need a different
specialist. I am not the right answer for every problem.
:::

## What I don't take on

To save us both time:

- Work that conflicts with my current role at Basra Energy Company
  Limited (BP / CNPC JV). I keep a strict conflict-of-interest framework
  and will decline anything that touches it.
- Work that requires me to use any prior-employer proprietary data,
  contractor performance information, or confidential figures.
- Generic data-science work outside wells engineering. I am a wells
  authority who has learned data, not a generalist data scientist.
- Open-ended advisory arrangements. Every capability on this page is
  sized to deliver something concrete in 5–30 days.

## Contact {#contact}
